name: backend-test-vehicle-registry
description: Vehicle registration system with license validation

scripts.help:
echo '
Available scripts:
  setup - Install dependencies and prepare environment
  build - Build TypeScript application
  dev - Run in development mode with hot reload
  start - Start production build
  seed - Populate database with test data
  test:api - Run automated API endpoint tests
  type-check - Check TypeScript types
  format - Format code with Prettier
  format:check - Check code formatting
  lint - Run ESLint
  lint:fix - Fix ESLint issues
  test - Run all tests (unit + integration)
  test:unit - Run unit tests only
  test:integration - Run integration tests only
  test:watch - Run tests in watch mode
  test:coverage - Run tests with coverage
  validate - Run all checks (type-check, lint, format:check, test)
  prisma:migrate - Run Prisma migrations
  prisma:generate - Generate Prisma client
  prisma:studio - Open Prisma Studio (GUI)

Quick Start:
  1. npm run dev        # Start server
  2. npm run seed       # Add test data
  3. npm run test:api   # Test endpoints

See API_TESTING.md for manual testing guide.
'
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
